article.headline: Joshua Hughes posts double-double to lead Evansville over Oregon State 73-69 at Paradise Jam
article.description: — Joshua Hughes finished with 16 points and 12 rebounds to lead Evansville to a 73-69 victory over Oregon State on Friday night at the Paradise Jam.

article.story: SAINT THOMAS, Virgin Islands -- — Joshua Hughes finished with 16 points and 12 rebounds to lead Evansville to a 73-69 victory over Oregon State on Friday night at the Paradise Jam. Hughes made 4 of 10 shots with two 3-pointers for the Purple Aces (3-3). Bryce Quinet had 15 points off the bench for Evansville. Leif Moeller had 14 points and Connor Turnbull scored 10. Noah Amenhauser had 17 points to lead the Beavers (3-2), who trailed 30-28 at halftime. Josiah Lake II scored 16. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season.
